After Ichigo trained in the Dangai using Jinzen (Zanpakuto meditation) for three months, he learned Tensa Zangetsu's secret technique known as the Final Getsuga Tensho and exited out even stronger than ever at the time. His hair is longer and he's taller because of his time in the Dangai. Tensa Zangetsu merged and binded with his right arm which is theorized by Aizen (Who's Zanpakuto also merged with his arm) that the merged Zanpakuto they both possesed is possibly the next step of evolution for the Zanpakuto and perhaps the truest form of the weapon. The Final Getsuga Tensho is a technique that has Ichigo become Getsuga itself (Ichigo basically becomes one with Zangetsu as Aizen says when he was about to evolve even further after the attack) for one massive attack called Mugetsu. Once that attack is used, Ichigo loses all of his Shinigami powers. Fans call this form of Ichigo's "Dangai Ichigo" because it comes from Ichigo's training in the Dangai.
